datasets.title: Bangladesh - Cox's Bazar District - Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazila Cyclone Shelter Locations
datasets.description: Based on requests from ECHO partners, REACH has worked to compile and map the location of cyclone shelters in Ukhia and Teknaf in the two Upazilas most affected by the Rohingya refugee influx of August 2017, in order to orient and inform humanitarian actors working in these locations. This database includes three lists of shelters: First, a list of shelters as designated on lists provided by the Cox's Bazar District Relief and Rehabilitation Officer (DRRO). Second, a list of cyclone shelters designated by the DRRO with additional structures reported to be shelters according to lists provided by the Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP), the District Disaster Managemen Plan (DDMP), Upazila Nirbahi Officers (UNOs), UNDP, IOM, UNHCR, WFP, the Local Government Engineering Department (LGED), and the Comprehensive Disaster Management Programme (CDMP). The third list mirrors the second list but also includes all of alternative names used by different agencies.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cox-s-bazar-district-teknaf-and-ukhiya-upazila-cyclone-shelter-locations]
datasets.details: All lists: None of the different databases used as the basis for this exercise employs a consistent system of unique identifier codes that would allow for effective matching of records between databases. As a result, in many cases different databases have used different names and terminologies to refer to the same shelters. Wherever possible REACH has worked to match the same shelters across different lists using GPS triangulation, fuzzy matching approaches, and site visits. However, given the limitations of the data matches are not warranted to be 100% accurate in all cases and further verification may be required.

entity.name: Cox's Bazar District Relief and Rehabilitation Officer (DRRO)

lineage.description: REACH compiled cyclone shelter locations in Ukhiya and Teknaf Upazilas by integrating official lists from the Cox's Bazar District Relief and Rehabilitation Officer (DRRO) with additional structures identified through field reporting. The resulting database geo-references three categories of shelters and was produced to support humanitarian actors orienting disaster preparedness and response in areas affected by the 2017 Rohingya refugee influx.

resources.title: REACH_BGD_Map_Ukhiya_Cyclone_Shelters_23Oct2019.pdf
resources.description: This map shows cyclone shelters in Ukhiya Upazila that appear on designated lists compiled by the Cox's Bazar DRRO, as well as shelter capacity data from these lists. The map also highlights other structures that are not included in DRRO lists but have been identified as cyclone shelters by other data sources including the Cox's Bazar District Disaster Management Programme, the Cyclone Preparedness Programme, UNDP, IOM, and UNHCR.
